nodes.rationale: Ensure codebase targets exact v56.0.0 Expo APIs.

nodes.label: Progress Tracking Logic (10s threshold)
nodes.rationale: Avoid recording very short accidental clicks under 10 seconds; record progress periodically every 5-10s.

nodes.label: Continue Watching Feature Plan
nodes.rationale: Allows users to resume movie or episode playback from their last watched timestamp with auto-completion at 90-95%.
